audit.recode_to: no reclassification: keep fixed-dominant final (final stress, not in the strict set, in the dominant set). Add caution/edge note from Voegelin 1935 fn. 4-5: word-stress is weak ('if one can speak of such a stress'), every doubled (long) vowel and every syllable closed by a glottalic phoneme is also stressed, and in phrase-final position (including slow citation forms, where 'some informants make every word a phrase') the final vowel(s) are unvoiced and the stress falls on the vowel preceding them -- so isolation forms may surface with pre-final prominence.
